prompt: For each channel, how many order lines are there, and how many of them have 2 or more units? Use the sales table. Return channel, n_lines and multi_unit_lines, one row per channel. Any row order is fine. Which query returns it?

options.text:
SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_unit_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY channel

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_unit_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY channel

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       COUNT(*) AS multi_unit_lines
FROM sales
WHERE units >= 2
GROUP BY channel

SELECT channel,
       COUNT(*) AS n_lines,
       SUM(CASE WHEN units >= 2 THEN units ELSE 0 END) AS multi_unit_lines
FROM sales
GROUP BY channel
